cc:Work.dc:title: CiteTutor recorded results and latency
cc:Work.dc:description: Earlier and revised runs on identical fixtures: correct supported answers 4/7 to 7/7, false refusals 3/7 to 0/7, out-of-scope refusals 3/3 in both. Prompts and runtime changed. A separate live supported Sentry trace took 45.73 seconds. Small authored fixture only.
